description.value: Krush Smoothie and Juice Bar is a fresh-drink café on 10th Avenue serving smoothies and juices. Located in the Port Alberni area of Vancouver Island, it offers a refreshing stop for cyclists on a demanding inland route. Cash, debit, and credit cards are all accepted.
